assumptions: Mission wording is an authored exercise inspired by the sources, not a transcription of historical orders.
Strength, readiness, supply, unit locations and enemy knowledge are unknown. Objective markers are approximate place references, not unit positions.
One communication step is a demonstration delay, not a minute or a calibrated WWII transmission model.
13 km sectors use shared reference geography, not generated ASL terrain.
Two real divisions with their six organic infantry regiments and eighteen battalions. This is not a complete divisional order of battle.
Historical attachments are context only. The playable order chain remains organic until operational control and dated transfers are implemented.
No amphibious invasion is simulated. Historical outcomes after opening are not scheduled or forced.

campaign.deploymentStatus: Historical infantry organization and dated area reports. Map badges are organizational callouts, not exact deployments. Actual strengths, equipment availability and front lines remain unverified.
campaign.eventStatus: No reinforcement, withdrawal, weather or daylight schedule has been reconstructed.
campaign.geographyStatus: Modern reference geography and transport research with mixed dates. Not a validated 8 June 1944 operational network.
campaign.purpose: Begin with Allied forces ashore. Expand the beachhead through inland operations; beaches provide abstract supply and reinforcement entry points.

scope.openingCondition: Established Allied beachhead; landing losses are prior history.
scope.reinforcements: Arrivals are abstract entry events when sourced; none scheduled in this package.

campaign.timeBasis: UTC is a simulation normalization. Midnight and the one-day boundary are authored prototype choices, not sourced operation start/end times.
